title: باب الأَمْرِ بِإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي إِلَى دَعْوَةٍ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ بِئْسَ الطَّعَامُ طَعَامُ الْوَلِيمَةِ يُدْعَى إِلَيْهِ الأَغْنِيَاءُ وَيُتْرَكُ الْمَسَاكِينُ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَأْتِ الدَّعْوَةَ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, that he used to say: What a bad food is the food of a wedding feast: the rich are invited to it and the poor are left out. Whoever does not attend the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, that he used to say: What a bad food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl: the rich are invited to it and the poor are left out. Whoever does not attend the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب الأَمْرِ بِإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي إِلَى دَعْوَةٍ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِلزُّهْرِيِّ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَيْفَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الأَغْنِيَاءِ فَضَحِكَ فَقَالَ لَيْسَ هُوَ شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الأَغْنِيَاءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَكَانَ أَبِي غَنِيًّا فَأَفْزَعَنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ حِينَ سَمِعْتُ بِهِ فَسَأَلْتُ عَنْهُ الزُّهْرِيَّ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الْوَلِيمَةِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ.
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. He said: I asked al-Zuhri: Abu Bakr, how is this hadith, “The worst food is the food of the rich”? He laughed and said: It is not “the worst food is the food of the rich.” Sufyan said: My father was wealthy, and this hadith frightened me when I heard it, so I asked al-Zuhri about it. He said: Abd al-Rahman al-Araj narrated to me that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The worst food is the food of a wedding feast. Then he mentioned something like Malik's hadith.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I asked al-Zuhri: Abu Bakr, how is this hadith, “The worst food is the food of the rich”? He laughed and said: It is not “the worst food is the food of the rich.” Sufyan said: My father was wealthy, and this hadith frightened me when I heard it, so I asked al-Zuhri about it. Er sagte: Abd al-Rahman al-Araj überlieferte mir that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The worst food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl. Then he mentioned something like Malik's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب الأَمْرِ بِإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي إِلَى دَعْوَةٍ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الْوَلِيمَةِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ. وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me, from Abd al-Razzaq. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib and from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The worst food is the food of a wedding feast, like Malik's hadith. Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, with similar wording.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte mir, from Abd al-Razzaq. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib and from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The worst food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl, like Malik's hadith. Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, with similar wording. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب الأَمْرِ بِإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي إِلَى دَعْوَةٍ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زِيَادَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ثَابِتًا، الأَعْرَجَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الْوَلِيمَةِ يُمْنَعُهَا مَنْ يَأْتِيهَا وَيُدْعَى إِلَيْهَا مَنْ يَأْبَاهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يُجِبِ الدَّعْوَةَ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. He said: I heard Ziyad ibn Sad say: I heard Thabit al-Araj narrate from Abu Hurayra that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: The worst food is the food of a wedding feast. It is withheld from whoever comes to it, while those who reject it are invited. Whoever does not accept the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Ziyad ibn Sad say: I heard Thabit al-Araj narrate from Abu Hurayra that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: The worst food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl. It is withheld from whoever comes to it, while those who reject it are invited. Whoever does not accept the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1433 a, book 16, باب لاَ تَحِلُّ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلاَثًا لِمُطَلِّقِهَا حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ وَيَطَأَهَا ثُمَّ يُفَارِقَهَا وَتَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا
title: باب لاَ تَحِلُّ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلاَثًا لِمُطَلِّقِهَا حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ وَيَطَأَهَا ثُمَّ يُفَارِقَهَا وَتَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةُ رِفَاعَةَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رِفَاعَةَ فَطَلَّقَنِي فَبَتَّ طَلاَقِي فَتَزَوَّجْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الزَّبِيرِ وَإِنَّ مَا مَعَهُ مِثْلُ هُدْبَةِ الثَّوْبِ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ لاَ حَتَّى تَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ وَيَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ عِنْدَهُ وَخَالِدٌ بِالْبَابِ يَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَهُ فَنَادَى يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَلاَ تَسْمَعُ هَذِهِ مَا تَجْهَرُ بِهِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Amr al-Naqid narrated to us, and the wording is Amr's. They both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: The wife of Rifaah came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said: I was with Rifaah, and he divorced me with an irrevocable divorce. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, but what he has is like the fringe of a garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and said: Do you want to return to Rifaah? No, not until you taste his intimacy and he tastes your intimacy. She said: Abu Bakr was with him, and Khalid was at the door waiting for permission. He called: Abu Bakr, do you not hear what this woman says openly in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him)?
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Amr al-Naqid überlieferte uns, and the wording is Amr's. They both said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: The wife of Rifaah came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: I was with Rifaah, and he geschieden me with an irrevocable Scheidung. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, but what he has is like the fringe of a garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and said: Do you want to return to Rifaah? No, not until you taste his Intimität and he tastes your Intimität. She said: Abu Bakr was with him, and Khalid was at the door waiting for permission. He called: Abu Bakr, do you not hear what this woman says openly in the presence of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm)? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب لاَ تَحِلُّ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلاَثًا لِمُطَلِّقِهَا حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ وَيَطَأَهَا ثُمَّ يُفَارِقَهَا وَتَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ الْقُرَظِيَّ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَبَتَّ طَلاَقَهَا فَتَزَوَّجَتْ بَعْدَهُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الزَّبِيرِ فَجَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَحْتَ رِفَاعَةَ فَطَلَّقَهَا آخِرَ ثَلاَثِ تَطْلِيقَاتٍ فَتَزَوَّجْتُ بَعْدَهُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الزَّبِيرِ وَإِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا مَعَهُ إِلاَّ مِثْلُ الْهُدْبَةِ وَأَخَذَتْ بِهُدْبَةٍ مِنْ جِلْبَابِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَاحِكًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّكِ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ لاَ حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ وَتَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ جَالِسٌ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَخَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ جَالِسٌ بِبَابِ الْحُجْرَةِ لَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ قَالَ فَطَفِقَ خَالِدٌ يُنَادِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَلاَ تَزْجُرُ هَذِهِ عَمَّا تَجْهَرُ بِهِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
translation_en: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me, and the wording is Harmalah's. Abu al-Tahir said: He narrated to us, and Harmalah said: Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr narrated to me that Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), told him: Rifaah al-Qurazi divorced his wife with an irrevocable divorce. She then married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr and came to the Prophet (peace be upon him), saying: Messenger of Allah, I was with Rifaah and he divorced me with the final of three divorces. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, and by Allah he has only something like a fringe. She took a fringe of her garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and laughed, then said: Perhaps you want to return to Rifaah? No, until he tastes your intimacy and you taste his intimacy. Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was sitting with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-As was sitting at the door of the room without permission. Khalid began calling Abu Bakr: Will you not stop this woman from saying openly what she says in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him)?

Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr überlieferte mir that Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), told him: Rifaah al-Qurazi geschieden his wife with an irrevocable Scheidung. She then married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr and came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), saying: Messenger of Allah, I was with Rifaah and he geschieden me with the final of three Scheidungs. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, and by Allah he has only something like a fringe. She took a fringe of her garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and laughed, then said: Perhaps you want to return to Rifaah? No, until he tastes your Intimität and you taste his Intimität. Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was sitting with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-As was sitting at the door of the room without permission. Khalid began calling Abu Bakr: Will you not stop this woman from saying openly what she says in the presence of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm)? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ الْقُرَظِيَّ، طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الزَّبِيرِ فَجَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ رِفَاعَةَ طَلَّقَهَا آخِرَ ثَلاَثِ تَطْلِيقَاتٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd ibn Humayd informed us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. Rifaah al-Qurazi divorced his wife, and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr married her. She came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said: Messenger of Allah, Rifaah divorced her with the final of three divorces. It is like the hadith of Yunus.
translation_de: Abd ibn Humayd berichtete uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. Rifaah al-Qurazi geschieden his wife, and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr married her. She came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: Messenger of Allah, Rifaah geschieden her with the final of three Scheidungs. It is like the hadith of Yunus. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب لاَ تَحِلُّ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلاَثًا لِمُطَلِّقِهَا حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ وَيَطَأَهَا ثُمَّ يُفَارِقَهَا وَتَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا الرَّجُلُ فَيُطَلِّقُهَا فَتَتَزَوَّجُ رَجُلاً فَيُطَلِّقُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا أَتَحِلُّ لِزَوْجِهَا الأَوَّلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about a woman whom a man marries and then divorces, after which she marries another man who divorces her before consummating the marriage: is she lawful for her first husband? He said: No, not until he tastes her intimacy.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about a woman whom a man marries and then Scheidungs, after which she marries another man who Scheidungs her before consummating the Ehe: is she lawful for her first husband? Er sagte: No, not until he tastes her Intimität. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ibn Fudayl narrated to us. Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. All of them narrated from Hisham with this chain.

title: باب لاَ تَحِلُّ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلاَثًا لِمُطَلِّقِهَا حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ وَيَطَأَهَا ثُمَّ يُفَارِقَهَا وَتَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ طَلَّقَ رَجُلٌ امْرَأَتَهُ ثَلاَثًا فَتَزَوَّجَهَا رَجُلٌ ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا فَأَرَادَ زَوْجُهَا الأَوَّلُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا فَسُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَتَّى يَذُوقَ الآخِرُ مِنْ عُسَيْلَتِهَا مَا ذَاقَ الأَوَّلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah ibn Umar, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha. She said: A man divorced his wife three times. Another man married her and then divorced her before consummating the marriage. Her first husband wanted to marry her, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about it. He said: No, not until the latter tastes of her intimacy what the first tasted.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Ali ibn Mushir überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah ibn Umar, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha. She said: A man geschieden his wife three times. Another man married her and then geschieden her before consummating the Ehe. Her first husband wanted to marry her, so der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was asked about it. Er sagte: No, not until the latter tastes of her Intimität what the first tasted. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب لاَ تَحِلُّ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلاَثًا لِمُطَلِّقِهَا حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ وَيَطَأَهَا ثُمَّ يُفَارِقَهَا وَتَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated it to us. My father narrated to us. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to us. Yahya, meaning Ibn Sa'id, narrated to us. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah with this meaning. In Yahya's narration from Ubayd Allah: al-Qasim narrated to us, from Aisha.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated it to us. My father überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to us. Yahya, meaning Ibn Sa'id, überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah with this meaning. In Yahya's narration from Ubayd Allah: al-Qasim überlieferte uns, from Aisha. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1434 a, book 16, باب مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يَقُولَهُ عِنْدَ الْجِمَاعِ ‏
title: باب مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يَقُولَهُ عِنْدَ الْجِمَاعِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهُ قَالَ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ يُقَدَّرْ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَدٌ فِي ذَلِكَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْطَانٌ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, and the wording is Yahya's. They both said: Jarir informed us, from Mansur, from Salim, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If one of you, when he intends to have intercourse with his wife, says, “In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from what You grant us,” and a child is decreed between them through that, Satan will never harm it.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns, and the wording is Yahya's. They both said: Jarir berichtete uns, from Mansur, from Salim, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If one of you, when he intends to have Geschlechtsverkehr with his wife, says, “In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from what You grant us,” and a child is decreed between them through that, Satan will never harm it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يَقُولَهُ عِنْدَ الْجِمَاعِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ شُعْبَةَ لَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ذِكْرُ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ قَالَ مَنْصُورٌ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Abd ibn Humayd informed us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. All of them narrated from al-Thawri, both from Mansur, with the meaning of Jarir's hadith. Shubah's narration does not mention “In the name of Allah.” Abd al-Razzaq's narration from al-Thawri does mention “In the name of Allah.” Ibn Numayr's narration says: Mansur, I think, said “In the name of Allah.”
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Abd ibn Humayd berichtete uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. All of them narrated from al-Thawri, both from Mansur, with the meaning of Jarir's hadith. Shubah's narration does not mention “In the name of Allah.” Abd al-Razzaq's narration from al-Thawri does mention “In the name of Allah.” Ibn Numayr's narration says: Mansur, I think, said “In the name of Allah.” Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ سَمِعَ جَابرًا يَقُولُ كَانَتِ الْيَهُودُ تَقُولُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ مِنْ دُبُرِهَا فِي قُبُلِهَا كَانَ الْوَلَدُ أَحْوَلَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="223" aya_end="223"]{‏ نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ‏}‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Amr al-Naqid narrated to us, and the wording is Abu Bakr's. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn al-Munkadir, who heard Jabir say: The Jews used to say that if a man had intercourse with his wife from behind in her vagina, the child would be cross-eyed. Then this was revealed: “Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth however you wish” (Quran 2:223).

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ يَهُودَ، كَانَتْ تَقُولُ إِذَا أُتِيَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ دُبُرِهَا فِي قُبُلِهَا ثُمَّ حَمَلَتْ كَانَ وَلَدُهَا أَحْوَلَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأُنْزِلَتْ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="223" aya_end="223"]{‏ نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ‏}‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us. al-Layth informed us, from Ibn al-Had, from Abu Hazim, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. The Jews used to say that if a woman was approached from behind in her vagina and became pregnant, her child would be cross-eyed. He said: Then this was revealed: “Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth however you wish” (Quran 2:223).
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Rumh überlieferte uns. al-Layth berichtete uns, from Ibn al-Had, from Abu Hazim, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. The Jews used to say that if a woman was approached from behind in her vagina and became pregnant, her child would be cross-eyed. Er sagte: Then this was revealed: “Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth however you wish” (Quran 2:223). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب جَوَازِ جِمَاعِهِ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي قُبُلِهَا مِنْ قُدَّامِهَا وَمِنْ وَرَائِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ تَعَرُّضٍ لِلدُّبُرِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ رَاشِدٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ إِنْ شَاءَ مُجَبِّيَةً وَإِنْ شَاءَ غَيْرَ مُجَبِّيَةٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ فِي صِمَامٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated it to us. Abu Awanah narrated to us. Abd al-Warith ibn Abd al-Samad narrated to us, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ayyub. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Rahman narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, Harun ibn Abd Allah, and Abu Main al-Raqashi narrated to me. They said: Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us. My father narrated to us: I heard al-Numan ibn Rashid narrate from al-Zuhri. Sulayman ibn Mabid narrated to me. Muala ibn Asad narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz, Ibn al-Mukhtar, narrated to us, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih. All of them narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir, with this hadith. In al-Numan's narration from al-Zuhri: whether she wishes, with him bent forward, or whether she wishes, in another manner, but all in one opening.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated it to us. Abu Awanah überlieferte uns. Abd al-Warith ibn Abd al-Samad überlieferte uns, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ayyub. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Wahb ibn Jarir überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Rahman überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, Harun ibn Abd Allah, and Abu Main al-Raqashi überlieferte mir. They said: Wahb ibn Jarir überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns: I heard al-Numan ibn Rashid narrate from al-Zuhri. Sulayman ibn Mabid überlieferte mir. Muala ibn Asad überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz, Ibn al-Mukhtar, überlieferte uns, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih. All of them narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir, with this hadith. In al-Numan's narration from al-Zuhri: whether she wishes, with him bent forward, or whether she wishes, in another manner, but all in one opening. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1436 a, book 16, باب تَحْرِيمِ امْتِنَاعِهَا مِنْ فِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ امْتِنَاعِهَا مِنْ فِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا بَاتَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ هَاجِرَةً فِرَاشَ زَوْجِهَا لَعَنَتْهَا الْمَلاَئِكَةُ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us, and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us. He said: I heard Qatadah narrate from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: When a woman spends the night abandoning her husband's bed, the angels curse her until morning.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns, and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's. Muhammad ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Qatadah narrate from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: When a woman spends the night abandoning her husband's bed, the Engel curse her until morning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1436 b, book 16, باب تَحْرِيمِ امْتِنَاعِهَا مِنْ فِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ امْتِنَاعِهَا مِنْ فِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Habib narrated it to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us with this chain and said: until she returns.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Habib narrated it to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns with this chain and said: until she returns. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ امْتِنَاعِهَا مِنْ فِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَدْعُو امْرَأَتَهُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهَا فَتَأْبَى عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ كَانَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ سَاخِطًا عَلَيْهَا حَتَّى يَرْضَى عَنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Marwan narrated to us, from Yazid, meaning Ibn Kaysan, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: By Him in whose hand is my soul, whenever a man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses him, the One who is in heaven remains angry with her until he is pleased with her.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Marwan überlieferte uns, from Yazid, meaning Ibn Kaysan, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: By Him in whose hand is my soul, whenever a man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses him, the One who is in heaven remains angry with her until he is pleased with her. title: باب تَحْرِيمِ امْتِنَاعِهَا مِنْ فِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا دَعَا الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلَمْ تَأْتِهِ فَبَاتَ غَضْبَانَ عَلَيْهَا لَعَنَتْهَا الْمَلاَئِكَةُ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to me. Waki narrated to us. Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and his is the wording. Jarir narrated to us. All of them narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When a man calls his wife to his bed and she does not come to him, and he spends the night angry with her, the angels curse her until morning.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns. Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj überlieferte mir. Waki überlieferte uns. Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir, and his is the wording. Jarir überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When a man calls his wife to his bed and she does not come to him, and he spends the night angry with her, the Engel curse her until morning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1437 a, book 16, باب تَحْرِيمِ إِفْشَاءِ سِرِّ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ إِفْشَاءِ سِرِّ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ الْعُمَرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَشَرِّ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَنْزِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الرَّجُلَ يُفْضِي إِلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَتُفْضِي إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْشُرُ سِرَّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Marwan ibn Muawiyah narrated to us, from Umar ibn Hamzah al-Umari. Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad narrated to us. He said: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the people in the lowest position before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has intercourse with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her secret.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Marwan ibn Muawiyah überlieferte uns, from Umar ibn Hamzah al-Umari. Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the people in the lowest position before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has Geschlechtsverkehr with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her Geheimnis. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1437 b, book 16, باب تَحْرِيمِ إِفْشَاءِ سِرِّ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏
title: باب تَحْرِيمِ إِفْشَاءِ سِرِّ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، بْنِ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ الأَمَانَةِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الرَّجُلَ يُفْضِي إِلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَتُفْضِي إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْشُرُ سِرَّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَعْظَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Umar ibn Hamzah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad. He said: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the greatest trusts before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has intercourse with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her secret. Ibn Numayr said: “The greatest.”
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Umar ibn Hamzah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad. Er sagte: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the greatest trusts before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has Geschlechtsverkehr with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her Geheimnis. Ibn Numayr said: “The greatest.” Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 a, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخْبَرَنِي رَبِيعَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو صِرْمَةَ عَلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ فَسَأَلَهُ أَبُو صِرْمَةَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ الْعَزْلَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةَ بَلْمُصْطَلِقِ فَسَبَيْنَا كَرَائِمَ الْعَرَبِ فَطَالَتْ عَلَيْنَا الْعُزْبَةُ وَرَغِبْنَا فِي الْفِدَاءِ فَأَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَسْتَمْتِعَ وَنَعْزِلَ فَقُلْنَا نَفْعَلُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا لاَ نَسْأَلُهُ ‏.‏ فَسَأَلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ خَلْقَ نَسَمَةٍ هِيَ كَائِنَةٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ سَتَكُونُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Ali ibn Hujr narrated to us. They said: Ismail ibn Jafar narrated to us. Rabi'ah informed me, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Ibn Muhayriz. He said: Abu Sirmah and I entered upon Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Abu Sirmah asked him: Abu Sa'id, did you hear the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) mention withdrawal? He said: Yes. We went with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the expedition to Banu al-Mustaliq, captured noble Arab women, and our separation from our wives became long. We desired ransom and wanted to have intercourse and withdraw. We said: We will do it while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is among us, without asking him. Then we asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he said: You are not at fault if you do not do it. No soul that Allah has decreed to be created until the Day of Resurrection will fail to be created.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Ali ibn Hujr überlieferte uns. They said: Ismail ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Rabi'ah berichtete mir, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Ibn Muhayriz. Er sagte: Abu Sirmah and I entered upon Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Abu Sirmah asked him: Abu Sa'id, did you hear der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) mention Coitus interruptus? Er sagte: Yes. We went with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) on the expedition to Banu al-Mustaliq, captured noble Arab women, and our separation from our wives became long. We desired ransom and wanted to have Geschlechtsverkehr and withdraw. We said: We will do it while der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) is among us, without asking him. Then we asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said: You are not at fault if you do not do it. No soul that Allah has decreed to be created until the Day of Resurrection will fail to be created. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 b, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ، مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الزِّبْرِقَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، بْنُ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ رَبِيعَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ مَنْ هُوَ خَالِقٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Faraj, the freedman of Banu Hashim, narrated to me. Muhammad ibn al-Zibriqan narrated to us. Musa ibn Uqbah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, with the meaning of Rabiah's hadith, except that he said: Allah has decreed whoever He is to create until the Day of Resurrection.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Faraj, the freedman of Banu Hashim, überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn al-Zibriqan überlieferte uns. Musa ibn Uqbah überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, with the meaning of Rabiah's hadith, except that he said: Allah has decreed whoever He is to create until the Day of Resurrection. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 c, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَصَبْنَا سَبَايَا فَكُنَّا نَعْزِلُ ثُمَّ سَأَلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَنَا ‏"‏ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَفْعَلُونَ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَفْعَلُونَ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَفْعَلُونَ مَا مِنْ نَسَمَةٍ كَائِنَةٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ هِيَ كَائِنَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma al-Dubai narrated to me. Juwayriyah narrated to us, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn Muhayriz, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He informed him: We captured female prisoners and practiced withdrawal. Then we asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about it, and he said to us: Do you really do it? Do you really do it? Do you really do it? No soul that is to exist until the Day of Resurrection will exist except that it will exist.
translation_de: Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma al-Dubai überlieferte mir. Juwayriyah überlieferte uns, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn Muhayriz, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He informed him: We captured female prisoners and practiced Coitus interruptus. Then we asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) about it, and he said to us: Do you really do it? Do you really do it? Do you really do it? No soul that is to exist until the Day of Resurrection will exist except that it will exist. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 d, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ نَعَمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ الْقَدَرُ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Nasr ibn Ali al-Jahdami narrated to us. Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Sirin, from Mabid ibn Sirin, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. I said to him: Did you hear it from Abu Sa'id? He said: Yes, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: You are not at fault if you do not do it; it is only destiny.
translation_de: Nasr ibn Ali al-Jahdami überlieferte uns. Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Anas ibn Sirin, from Mabid ibn Sirin, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. I said to him: Did you hear it from Abu Sa'id? Er sagte: Yes, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: You are not at fault if you do not do it; it is only Schicksal. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 e, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ حَبِيبٍ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ وَبَهْزٌ قَالُوا جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي الْعَزْلِ ‏"‏ لاَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا ذَاكُمْ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ الْقَدَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ بَهْزٍ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ قُلْتُ لَهُ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Yahya ibn Habib narrated to us. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi and Bahz narrated to us. They all narrated from Shubah, from Anas ibn Sirin, with this chain and the same meaning. In their narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him), concerning withdrawal, he said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only destiny. In Bahz's narration, Shubah said: I asked him whether he heard it from Abu Sa'id, and he said: Yes.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Habib überlieferte uns. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi and Bahz überlieferte uns. They all narrated from Shubah, from Anas ibn Sirin, with this chain and the same meaning. In their narration from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), concerning Coitus interruptus, he said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only Schicksal. In Bahz's narration, Shubah said: I asked him whether he heard it from Abu Sa'id, and he said: Yes. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 f, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بِشْرِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، رَدَّهُ إِلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْعَزْلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا ذَاكُمْ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ الْقَدَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَقَوْلُهُ ‏"‏ لاَ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى النَّهْىِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to me, and the wording is Abu Kamil's. They both said: Hammad, Ibn Zayd, narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr ibn Masud, who traced it back to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was asked about withdrawal and said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only destiny. Muhammad said: The wording “you are not at fault” is closer to a prohibition.
translation_de: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari überlieferte mir, and the wording is Abu Kamil's. They both said: Hammad, Ibn Zayd, überlieferte uns. Ayyub überlieferte uns, from Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr ibn Masud, who traced it back to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was asked about Coitus interruptus and said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only Schicksal. Muhammad said: The wording “you are not at fault” is closer to a prohibition. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 g, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَدَّ الْحَدِيثَ حَتَّى رَدَّهُ إِلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ ذُكِرَ الْعَزْلُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ لَهُ الْمَرْأَةُ تُرْضِعُ فَيُصِيبُ مِنْهَا وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ مِنْهُ وَالرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ لَهُ الأَمَةُ فَيُصِيبُ مِنْهَا وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا ذَاكُمْ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ الْقَدَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ الْحَسَنَ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَكَأَنَّ هَذَا زَجْرٌ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Muadh ibn Muadh narrated to us. Ibn Awn narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr al-Ansari. He traced the hadith back to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Withdrawal was mentioned before the Prophet (peace be upon him), and he said: What is this? They said: A man has a wife who nurses, so he has intercourse with her but dislikes that she become pregnant by him; and a man has a slave woman, so he has intercourse with her but dislikes that she become pregnant by him. He said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only destiny. Ibn Awn said: I told al-Hasan this, and he said: By Allah, it sounds like a rebuke.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Muadh ibn Muadh überlieferte uns. Ibn Awn überlieferte uns, from Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr al-Ansari. He traced the hadith back to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Withdrawal was mentioned before der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said: What is this? They said: A man has a wife who nurses, so he has Geschlechtsverkehr with her but dislikes that she become pregnant by him; and a man has a slave woman, so he has Geschlechtsverkehr with her but dislikes that she become pregnant by him. Er sagte: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only Schicksal. Ibn Awn said: I told al-Hasan this, and he said: By Allah, it sounds like a rebuke. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1438 h, book 16, باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
title: باب حُكْمِ الْعَزْلِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثْتُ مُحَمَّدًا، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بِحَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ - يَعْنِي حَدِيثَ الْعَزْلِ - فَقَالَ إِيَّاىَ حَدَّثَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ‏.‏
translation_en: Hajjaj ibn al-Shair narrated to me. Sulayman ibn Harb narrated to us. Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ibn Awn. He said: I told Muhammad, from Ibrahim, the hadith of Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr, meaning the hadith about withdrawal. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr told it to me.
translation_de: Hajjaj ibn al-Shair überlieferte mir. Sulayman ibn Harb überlieferte uns. Hammad ibn Zayd überlieferte uns, from Ibn Awn. Er sagte: I told Muhammad, from Ibrahim, the hadith of Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr, meaning the hadith about Coitus interruptus. Er sagte: Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr told it to me.
